claim_text: Table 3: FluxNet-LAP depth MAE 3.12e-3 vs 6.74e-3 for the best baseline (Box+Mass projection); conservation error 3.3e-7 -> 3.3e-8.
blockers: No code repository URL appears anywhere in the paper text (searched for 'github', 'zenodo', 'anonymous.4open', 'code is available' -> zero hits).
No dataset URL or dataset-generation script is provided; all four benchmarks use simulation data generated by the authors with unpublished solver settings.

Reproducing the number requires full pushforward training (AdamW, K-step unroll) of both a ResNet and an FNO backbone plus 3-4 baselines, multi-seed, which is far outside an 8h CPU budget even if the data existed.
The 2D shallow-water dataset (dry regions, periodic BC, specific IC family) is not released and its generation parameters are not stated in the main text.

Note for the reader: 3.12e-3 is the ResNet-backbone FluxNet-LAP entry while 6.74e-3 is the FNO-backbone Box+Mass projection entry; within the ResNet backbone the projection baseline is 22.1e-3, and within the FNO backbone FluxNet-LAP is 2.22e-3. The comparison as anchored crosses backbone categories.
covered_elsewhere: The structural half (conservation error at the 1e-7..1e-8 level) is established generically by claim 1.
